title: Check Active and Archived Location Dwell Records
summary: Use read-only SSMS access to the WCS / Helix Robotics database to inspect active AGV dwell records at locations marked for dwell tracking, determine dwell time, and verify that the record is archived to Location Dwell Activity after the AGV leaves.
when_to_use: Use this diagnostic when investigating how long an AGV has remained at a tracked sort location or when verifying the transition from an active dwell record to an archived dwell record in the WCS / Helix DB (SSMS).
not_for: Do not use this procedure to modify, delete, or otherwise change dwell records.
Do not expect a completed dwell to remain in Location Active Dwell after the AGV leaves the tracked location.

roles_and_responsibilities.responsibility: Perform the read-only SSMS inspection of the Robotics database, interpret active and archived dwell records, and escalate missing or inconsistent records.

access_required: L2_support access to the WCS / Helix DB (SSMS)
system_preconditions: The AGV and sort location under investigation are known.
The location is marked for dwell tracking when an active dwell record is expected.

visual_references.description: Robotics Database Location Active Dwell Model showing AgvName, Station, SortGuid, and archived dwell examples with Start Time, Finish Time, and Total Time.

steps.title: Open the Robotics database dwell model in SSMS
steps.purpose: Navigate to the live database model that contains current dwell records.
steps.instruction: In the WCS / Helix DB (SSMS), open the Robotics database and locate the Location Active Dwell model table.
steps.expected_result: The Location Active Dwell table is available for inspection and represents active dwells at sort locations marked for dwell tracking.
steps.healthy_condition: The Robotics database exposes the Location Active Dwell model table for read-only inspection.
steps.failure_condition: The Location Active Dwell model table cannot be located or cannot be inspected with the available SSMS access.

actions.label: Open Robotics database
actions.exact_action: Open the Robotics database in SSMS.

actions.label: Locate active dwell table
actions.exact_action: Locate the Location Active Dwell model table.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if the Robotics database or Location Active Dwell model table is unavailable.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The Location Active Dwell model table displays the active dwells at sort locations marked for dwell tracking.
The LocationActiveDwellModel table displays the active dwells at locations marked for DwellTracking.

steps.title: Inspect the active dwell record
steps.purpose: Confirm whether the investigated AGV and sort location have a current dwell record.
steps.instruction: In the Location Active Dwell table on the WCS / Helix DB (SSMS), inspect the active record for the investigated sort location and AGV. Use the displayed AgvName, Station, and SortGuid values to identify the current dwell.
steps.expected_result: An AGV currently sitting at a tracked location has a corresponding active dwell record.
steps.healthy_condition: The active record identifies the expected AGV and station, with a SortGuid available when shown by the table.
steps.failure_condition: No active record is present for an AGV that is expected to be dwelling at the tracked location.

actions.label: Check active dwell
actions.exact_action: Inspect the Location Active Dwell record for the investigated AGV and sort location.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate when an expected active dwell record is missing.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The LocationActiveDwellModel table displays active dwells at locations marked for DwellTracking, with AgvName, Station, and SortGuid shown.
Dwell time is how long an AGV has been sitting at a particular location.

steps.title: Determine the active dwell time
steps.purpose: Determine how long the AGV has remained at the tracked location.
steps.instruction: In the WCS / Helix DB (SSMS), use the available dwell-time information associated with the active dwell record to determine how long the AGV has been sitting at the location.
steps.expected_result: The active dwell record provides enough observable time information to determine the AGV's dwell duration.
steps.healthy_condition: The dwell duration can be determined for the identified AgvName and Station.
steps.failure_condition: The dwell duration cannot be determined from the available active dwell information.

actions.label: Review dwell time
actions.exact_action: Use the available dwell-time information to determine how long the AGV has been at the location.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate when the dwell duration cannot be determined.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Dwell time is how long an AGV has been sitting at a location.
The dwell model examples show Start Time, Finish Time, and Total Time for dwell activity.

steps.title: Verify the archived dwell record after departure
steps.purpose: Confirm that the completed dwell moved from the active table to the activity archive after the AGV left the location.
steps.instruction: After the AGV leaves the tracked location, inspect Location Dwell Activity in the WCS / Helix DB (SSMS). Locate the completed dwell using the available AGV, station, sort, and time information rather than expecting it to remain in Location Active Dwell.
steps.expected_result: The completed dwell is present in Location Dwell Activity after the AGV leaves, with observable archived timing such as Start Time, Finish Time, and Total Time when displayed.
steps.healthy_condition: The dwell is no longer expected to be active and a corresponding archived record can be located in Location Dwell Activity.
steps.failure_condition: A record remains active after the AGV has left, or the completed dwell cannot be located in Location Dwell Activity.

actions.label: Open dwell activity
actions.exact_action: Inspect Location Dwell Activity in the Robotics database.

actions.label: Verify archived timing
actions.exact_action: Check the archived record's Start Time, Finish Time, and Total Time when those fields are displayed.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate when a record remains active after the AGV has left.
Escalate when the same dwell cannot be located in Location Dwell Activity.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Once the AGV leaves, the activity is archived to Location Dwell Activity.

The LocationActiveDwellModel table displays active dwells; once the AGV leaves, the activity is archived to LocationDwellActivity. Archived examples show AgvName, Station, SortGuid, Start Time, Finish Time, and Total Time.

success_criteria: The investigated AGV and tracked station can be identified in Location Active Dwell while the AGV is dwelling.
The available dwell-time information is sufficient to determine how long the AGV has been at the location.
After the AGV leaves, the completed dwell is found in Location Dwell Activity with observable archived timing when displayed.
healthy_conditions: An AGV currently at a location marked for dwell tracking has an active Location Active Dwell record.
The active record identifies the AGV and station through fields such as AgvName and Station.
After departure, the dwell is archived to Location Dwell Activity.
The archived record can show Start Time, Finish Time, and Total Time.
failure_conditions: An expected active dwell record is missing.
The dwell duration cannot be determined.
A dwell record remains active after the AGV leaves.
The completed dwell cannot be located in Location Dwell Activity.
escalation_guidance: Escalate to the appropriate WCS / Helix database support path when an expected active record is missing.
Escalate when dwell duration cannot be determined from the available fields.
Escalate when active-to-archived transition does not occur as expected.
Do not modify dwell records while investigating.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: Location Active Dwell displays active dwells at tracked sort locations. Dwell time is how long an AGV has been sitting at a location. After the AGV leaves, the activity is archived to Location Dwell Activity.
